blocked_sentences: No more than one creature can attack you each combat.

needs.what: a player-wide static capping how many creatures may attack the static's controller in a single combat (affects_player: "you", amount: {"const": 1}), enforced as an attack-declaration restriction (508.1c) so a declaration with two or more attackers aimed at that player is illegal
